sloka: अद्य ते मामका बाणास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः।पास्यन्ति रुधिरं गात्राद्बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् ।। ६.७१.६२ ।।
transliteration: adya te māmakā bāṇāstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ।pāsyanti rudhiraṁ gātrādbāṇaśalyāntarotthitam ।। 6.71.62 ।।

translations.english: "Now, you will drink the blood ejected from your neck by the holes made with my pointed arrows decked with polished gold."
